routes.title: Production agents
routes.first_step: Read the shutdown resource, then prepare a small example showing what happens to accepted work when a process stops.
routes.small_step: Read one existing Tokio discussion and record the recovery question it leaves open.
routes.prerequisites: Basic async Rust helps; use documentation reading before attempting a runtime change.

routes.title: Types and contracts
routes.first_step: Read one linked source and one Types Team meeting note; separate stable behavior from design proposals.
routes.small_step: Try one Rust exercise and explain which invalid states its types prevent.
routes.prerequisites: Reading a design note is open to newcomers; compiler changes require issue-specific preparation.

routes.title: Infrastructure configuration
routes.first_step: Compare the session reading with Snix scope; write down one configuration error that needs a runtime check.
routes.small_step: Read the project limitations and one related Nix discussion before proposing a change.
routes.prerequisites: Nix knowledge helps with implementation. Snix describes unstable APIs and early development.

routes.title: Robotics and embedded systems
routes.first_step: Read the protocol resource and prepare a question about confirming physical state after a command.
routes.small_step: Choose a documentation task or read an embedded meeting agenda without buying hardware.
routes.prerequisites: Workshop access and async Rust readiness are separate checks; hardware and ROS support depend on the exercise.

regional_gaps: Africa: Rust Africa, Johannesburg, and Kenya routes were checked; no future dated African meetup was verified.
Asia: dated Bengaluru, Tel Aviv, and Japanese meetup records sit alongside broader regional routes. Chinese OS camp end dates conflict; no calendar span was invented.
Europe and the Americas: selected organizers and Spanish, Portuguese, Czech, Dutch, German, French, Polish, and English routes were checked. Many cities and university groups remain unlisted.
Oceania: Melbourne and Canberra have dated events; Brisbane and Wellington have discovery routes. Sydney remains an archive route, and New Zealand future dates are unverified.
Online: published instances are included. Later chapter schedules, generic recurrence rules, and private-channel announcements were not converted into assumed meeting instances.
Global: announcements after 17 October 2026, unindexed pages, access-blocked sources, and private groups remain outside this review. No source claims worldwide completeness.
